name: FaithEval
description: FaithEval is a comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate the faithfulness of large language models in contextual scenarios across three tasks: unanswerable, inconsistent, and counterfactual contexts. It measures how well models avoid hallucinations and remain aligned with the provided context, simulating real-world retrieval challenges.
reputation: A recent faithfulness benchmark that is gaining attention for evaluating hallucination resistance in contextual settings, but it is not yet a long-established standard.
notes: Includes a rigorous four-stage context construction and validation framework with both LLM-based auto-evaluation and human validation.
